notes: Four waw+לֹא pairs are fused as *nor*/*neither* under rule 35, each headed on the negative, with the intervening גַּם taking its own *yet*.

The two assimilated articles before `נְּבֹנִים` and `יֹּדְעִים` are `unrepresented`: the ASV writes *men of understanding* / *men of skill*, whose supplied generic noun belongs to the substantive under rule 31. Giving the article that *men* was the competing reading.
*happeneth to* takes the marker under rule 16's first family; `כֻּלָּם` splits into *all* and *them* (rule 19).
